svg.title: Neoadjuvant therapy and the esophageal cancer immune microenvironment | 18 original studies
svg.desc: Horizontal timeline by first online publication date. Each card lists the author, journal, summary, and DOI. Squamous cell carcinoma and adenocarcinoma are labeled separately.
svg.text: Neoadjuvant Therapy and the Esophageal Cancer Immune Microenvironment
18 original studies · ESCC and EAC shown separately · first online publication
Single-agent or chemoradiotherapy benchmarks → paired combination studies → randomized evidence and spatial mechanisms

g.title: The single cell transcriptional landscape of esophageal adenocarcinoma and its modulation by neoadjuvant chemotherapy — Wayne Croft et al., Molecular Cancer, 2022-10-17. EAC. T-cell activation and exhaustion coexist after chemotherapy in EAC. DOI 10.1186/s12943-022-01666-x

Impacts of neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy on the immune landscape of esophageal squamous cell carcinoma — Jing Wen et al., eBioMedicine, 2022-11-23. ESCC. Post-chemoradiotherapy: more CD8⁺ T cells, exhaustion and myeloid remodeling. DOI 10.1016/j.ebiom.2022.104371

Neoadjuvant chemotherapy enhances anti-tumor immune response of tumor microenvironment in human esophageal squamous cell carcinoma — Sho Okuda et al., iScience, 2023-03-21. ESCC. The chemotherapy group had stronger CD8⁺ T-cell memory and less exhaustion. DOI 10.1016/j.isci.2023.106480
g.text: The chemotherapy group had stronger CD8⁺

g.title: Single-cell profiling of response to neoadjuvant chemo-immunotherapy in surgically resectable esophageal squamous cell carcinoma — Gang Ji and Qi Yang (co-first authors), Genome Medicine, 2024-04-02. ESCC. Pretreatment CD8⁺ T and NK cell IFNγ programs were stronger in patients with pCR. DOI 10.1186/s13073-024-01320-9
g.text: Pretreatment CD8⁺ T and NK cell IFNγ programs
were stronger in patients with pCR.

g.title: Neoadjuvant chemotherapy with or without camrelizumab in resectable esophageal squamous cell carcinoma: the randomized phase 3 ESCORT-NEO/NCCES01 trial — Jianjun Qin et al., Nature Medicine, 2024-07-02. ESCC. ESCORT-NEO: pCR rates were 28.0%, 15.4%, and 4.7% across the three groups. DOI 10.1038/s41591-024-03064-w

Doublet chemotherapy, triplet chemotherapy, or doublet chemotherapy combined with radiotherapy as neoadjuvant treatment for locally advanced oesophageal cancer (JCOG1109 NExT): a randomised, controlled, open-label, phase 3 trial — Ken Kato et al., The Lancet, 2024-07-06. ESCC. JCOG1109: triplet chemotherapy improved overall survival versus the doublet. DOI 10.1016/S0140-6736(24)00745-1

Spatial proteomic profiling elucidates immune determinants of neoadjuvant chemo-immunotherapy in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma — Chao Wu, Guoqing Zhang, Lin Wang, and Jinlong Hu (co-first authors), Oncogene, 2024-08-09. ESCC. Spatial CD8⁺ T/B-cell organization in TLS was linked to pathological response. DOI 10.1038/s41388-024-03123-z
g.text: Spatial CD8⁺ T/B-cell organization in TLS

g.title: Single-cell sequencing reveals immune features of treatment response to neoadjuvant immunochemotherapy in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma — Zhenlin Yang, He Tian, Xiaowei Chen, and Bozhao Li (co-first authors), Nature Communications, 2024-10-22. ESCC. Baseline CXCL13⁺ CD8⁺ T cells tracked with response; post-treatment states differed. DOI 10.1038/s41467-024-52977-0
g.text: Baseline CXCL13⁺ CD8⁺ T cells tracked with

g.title: Perioperative nivolumab and chemotherapy in locally advanced squamous cell carcinoma of the oesophagus: a randomized multicentre phase 2 study with circulating tumor DNA dynamics monitoring — Heng Jiao, Siyun Lin, Jianmin Gu, Dongxian Jiang, Peng Cui et al., Molecular Cancer, 2025-05-15. ESCC. Nivolumab plus chemotherapy did not significantly increase pCR (15.0% vs 13.3%). DOI 10.1186/s12943-025-02332-8

ctDNA detects residual disease after neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy and guides adjuvant therapy in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma — Zhichao Liu, Guoqiang Wang, Yang Yang et al., Cell Reports Medicine, 2025-09-16. ESCC. Adding ctDNA to routine reassessment improved sensitivity for detecting non-pCR. DOI 10.1016/j.xcrm.2025.102334
g.text: Adding ctDNA to routine reassessment improved

g.title: PRDM1⁺ Malignant Cells Mediate an Immunosuppressive Landscape and Resistance to Neoadjuvant Chemoradiotherapy and Immunotherapy in Esophageal Squamous Cell Carcinoma — Dijian Shen, Rui Li, Yong She, Xuefei Liu, Yuanyang Huang, and Yongling Ji (co-first authors), Advanced Science, 2026-01-20. ESCC. PRDM1⁺ tumor cells rose after nICRT in non-MPR, alongside Tregs and TREM2⁺ TAMs. DOI 10.1002/advs.202515207
g.text: PRDM1⁺ tumor cells rose after nICRT in
non-MPR, alongside Tregs and TREM2⁺ TAMs.

g.title: Sequential versus concurrent neoadjuvant immunochemotherapy in locally advanced esophageal squamous cell carcinoma: a randomized, controlled, open-label, phase 2 trial (HCHTOG1906) — Yan Zheng et al., Frontiers in Immunology, 2026-05-07. ESCC. Same-day vs staggered immunotherapy: no significant pCR difference. DOI 10.3389/fimmu.2026.1770662

Targeting VEGF signaling and stromal remodeling enhances chemoimmunotherapy efficacy in esophageal cancer — Zhongjian Yu, Wenjia Li, Shiting Xu, Meng Xu, and Qi Lin (co-first authors), Journal for ImmunoTherapy of Cancer, 2026-05-22. ESCC. A collagen-rich endothelial and fibroblast niche was linked to resistance. DOI 10.1136/jitc-2025-014249

CX3CR1⁺ CD8⁺ cytotoxic T cells drive tumor killing in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma during neoadjuvant therapy — Yahui Zhao, Ruixiang Zhang, Yang Li, Songming Liu, Cheng Liu, and Yuhao Wang (co-first authors), Nature Communications, 2026-08-22. ESCC. Responding tumors were enriched for cytotoxic CX3CR1⁺ CD8⁺ effector T cells. DOI 10.1038/s41467-026-76959-6
g.text: cytotoxic CX3CR1⁺ CD8⁺ effector T cells.

g.title: Coordinated cellular programmes distinguish responses to neoadjuvant PD-L1 blockade and potentiate combinatorial immunotherapy in ESCC — Si Li, Jiyu Guo, Jianqun Ma et al., Gut, 2026-09-18. ESCC. Coordinated T, B and macrophage programs tracked with response to PD-L1 blockade. DOI 10.1136/gutjnl-2026-339071
g.text: Coordinated T, B and macrophage programs
tracked with response to PD-L1 blockade.

g.title: Targeting UDP-GlcNAc–mediated O-GlcNAcylation in regulatory T cells attenuates immunotherapy resistance in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma — Yuchen Zhang, Pingjing Zhou, and Hongyu Zhang (co-first authors), Cell Death & Disease, 2026-11-03. ESCC. UDP-GlcNAc marked nonresponse; models support Treg ferroptosis resistance. DOI 10.1038/s41419-026-09371-z

The Th17–CAF–B-cell axis and de novo tertiary lymphoid structures — Zihang Mai et al., Drug Resistance Updates, 2026-11-07. ESCC. Functional experiments support a Th17–CAF–B-cell axis linked to new TLS. DOI 10.1016/j.drup.2026.101502
g.text: Th17–CAF–B-cell axis linked to new TLS.

g.title: Distinct T cell subsets associated with responses to different neoadjuvant treatments in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma — Xin-Yun Song et al., Cell Reports Medicine, 2026-11-11. ESCC. CD8⁺ T-cell clonal changes varied by neoadjuvant regimen. DOI 10.1016/j.xcrm.2026.103162
g.text: CD8⁺ T-cell clonal changes varied by

svg.text: Paired and spatial studies describe cellular changes; randomized endpoints do not directly establish mechanisms. A yellow star marks a SYSUCC collaboration.
